card.name: Q-abbreviations for dosing frequency
card.fires_on: Pieces of Latin-style abbreviations that begin with q, such as q.i.d., qid, q.d., QD and q.s., right after a dose amount. It fires on the letters after the q, or on the q itself.

modes.label: Inside q.i.d. / q.d.
modes.description: The second piece of a dosing-frequency abbreviation beginning with q.
modes.example: adults, 50 mg to 100 mg four times daily (q.i<<.d>>.); children under 6 years,

modes.label: Capital or bare Q after mg
modes.description: The Q of QD or q.i.d. directly after a milligram amount.

modes.label: q.s. in formulas
modes.description: The piece after q in q.s. (quantity sufficient) in ingredient lists.
modes.example: Sodium Chloride Injection, USP (0.9% benzyl alcohol) q<<.s>>. to 100 mL Since
